policy.providerSubmissionRule: Provider citations and provider-authored summaries never decide truth or eligibility.
policy.independentDecisionRule: Only verified-fail can force a specially adjudicated candidate to zero; unresolved decisions prevent finalization.
policy.sharingRule: An independent decision is keyed by canonical company plus submitted lane and reused across every system occurrence.
policy.comparisonRule: Rank within each channel and average three fixed ten-slot channel scores.
policy.humanAuditRule: No new blind audit; v1.3 confirmed role, lane, fit and cooperation-path judgments are unchanged.

interpretation.mainRanking: Candidate value after provider-neutral verification and confirmed v1.3 calibration.
interpretation.provider_evidence_completeness: Zero-weight structural diagnostic only; it is neither a correctness score nor a value gate.
